title: Mark Consuelos Reveals He's Facing 'Major' Toe Surgery After Delaying It for a Year: 'It Hurts' - NewsBreak
text:
By Vanessa Bermudez ,
1 days ago ZUMAPRESS.com / MEGA Mark Consuelos is going under the knife.
During the Friday, September 25, episode of Live with Kelly and Mark, Consuelos, 55, revealed that he’s scheduled to undergo a procedure on his toe immediately after the show.
“Today’s the day,” he told his wife and cohost, Kelly Ripa . “I’ve been putting off this toe surgery for about a year.”
Consuelos shared that he was already feeling “a little loopy” ahead of the procedure because he had been fasting since the previous day.
While Consuelos didn’t share many details, he clarified that the surgery was necessary and not simply to improve his golf game, as Ripa, 55, jokingly suggested.
“No, it’s arthritic, it’s bad,” he said. “I need help. Yeah, it hurts.”
“Basically, he’s having a pedicure,” his former All My Children costar later teased.
“No, I’m not! This is a major surgery,” her husband insisted, joking that “it’s like a C-section for your toe.”
Photo credit: ZUMAPRESS.com / MEGA Ripa confirmed that she’d be accompanying her husband to the hospital, though she admitted she had a selfish reason for going along.
“I’m not resisting the opportunity to video capture you coming out of your propofol haze,” she quipped.
Consuelos previously opened up about an arthritic condition in his toe after years of playing soccer during a November 2024 episode of Live with Kelly and Mark.
“Playing soccer, I got turf toe. I had the left one done about 10 years ago, 15 years ago?” Consuelos said, per Page Six . “Do you know, toe pain, they say, is worse than childbirth. They say that.”
Consuelos’ joke was met with loud boos from the audience. Consuelos later backpedaled, clarifying that he was only joking with the ladies.
